title: chromatotriccum × intermedium
intro: Chromatotriccum × intermedium, commonly known as Intermediate Broomrape, is a parasitic flowering plant that belongs to the Orobanchaceae family. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromatotriccum × intermedium include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases.
